description: Save a social post to the creator's BAMF saved-posts inbox from a post URL and/or a screenshot URL. Use when the user says 'save this post' or shares a post. Set remix=true (or include 'remix this' in text) to also start a remix: the creator's own idea plus a BAMF house template, using the saved post for structure only. Never schedules or publishes.

idea.description: The creator's own angle for the remix.

screenshot_url.description: Hosted screenshot of the post when there is no URL.

text.description: The user's message, used for URL and intent detection.

url.description: Post URL (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube).

name: bamf.save_post
